'''2012 Alderaan Regionals Anthony Massung DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Massung]] at [[2012 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
